description: Waterfall Plume is two charts in one visual. Put a field in Category and a measure in Values for a classic waterfall, like Power BI's own, with what forums have asked for for years. Add a Quantity measure and it becomes a price-volume-mix bridge that explains a revenue or margin change between two periods. Free features, no watermark Native parity: Category, Breakdown with maximum breakdowns and Others, Tooltips, increase / decrease / total colors, axis from zero, sorting. Start and end values: opening balance to closing balance, with a gap bar when the steps do not add up. Budget to actual (or last year to this year) by category with a reference measure. Total shown, hidden or renamed; custom step order; one bar per measure for an income statement built from measures. Connectors dotted, dashed or solid, in your color; arrows so direction never relies on color alone. Price-volume-mix bridge: volume, mix, price, new and discontinued products, computed product by product; the effects add up exactly to the total change; plain-language tooltips. Dynamic formatting: drive any Format pane setting with a DAX measure. Your colors: follows the report theme; custom colors; Minimal and Black & White styles; high contrast, keyboard, cross-filtering, right-click menu, English and French. Premium features ★ Subtotals at the positions you choose (Gross margin, EBITDA) and "set as total".…
